Government Official
Ability - Eyes On You
Once per round, use the companion app to secretly inspect one random Information Card from another player.
You may use what you learn however you want.
You do not have to reveal that you used the ability.
Congratulations, you now know something that everyone else desperately wants to know.
What you do with it is up to you.
Journalist
Ability - On Record
Choose one player.
Use the companion app to ask them whether their hand contains evidence supporting a specific response.
They must answer publicly.
They may lie.
The question itself becomes public information.
Sometimes asking the right question is more useful than having the right card.
Analyst
Ability - Final Call (Once per game)
Before voting, choose one response and lock your vote to it.
- Correct: You are immune to the next shadowban
- Wrong: You are shadowbanned for the next round
Basically, make a call and hope future-you doesn't hate past-you.
Investigator
Ability - Crosscheck
Choose two players.
The companion app tells you whether they are working for the same side or different sides.
You do not learn their exact roles.
You may choose whether or not to reveal what you learned.
Now you know something.
Whether anyone believes you is another problem.
ALGORITHM ROLES
Echo Chamber
Ability - Closed Circuit
Choose one player.
For the next 30 seconds, only you and that player may speak.
Everyone else must listen.
The affected player can still communicate through gestures or by showing cards if another rule allows it.
After 30 seconds, normal discussion resumes.
Sometimes the best way to control a conversation is to remove most of the conversation.
Influencer
Ability - Mute
The Influencer's ability activates when they are Shadowbanned.
Before being eliminated, they choose one remaining player.
That player is muted for the next round.
A muted player may not speak during the next discussion.
They may still:
* Show Information Cards
* Use allowed role abilities
* Vote
After the round ends, the mute effect expires.
The Influencer is then removed from the game.
So even after getting kicked out, you can still make everyone's life slightly worse.
Hacker
Ability - Account Breach
Choose one player.
The companion app reveals:
* Their role
* One random Information Card from their hand
The Hacker may keep this information private.
You broke into someone's account.
Please use your newfound power responsibly.
Or don't.
You're the Hacker.
Algorithm
Ability - For You
Choose one player.
That player receives one additional Information Card.
They may read it privately.
They now have more information than the rest of the table.
The Algorithm can use this ability to help a player, confuse them, or simply give them another piece of information to work with.
The player receiving the card does not learn why they received it.
